title: Coherent pull comparisons for integral residue reduction
statement: For a prime ℓ and a normed extension E of Qℓ, use the actual coefficient rings and derived reduction of [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Write UΛ(f) for the actual derived module pullback and RΛ(f) for direct image. IntegralResiduePullComparisons is the structure consisting of natural isomorphisms UO(f) followed by reduction ≅ reduction followed by UA(f), for every morphism of schemes, satisfying the explicit componentwise composition equation with leftDerivedUpperStarComp. Its push comparison is constructed as the mate of the inverse pull comparison. The typed functor wrappers are the existing functors, not additional chosen data.

source.place: Lemma 6.5.9(3), Proposition 6.8.11(3), Remark 6.8.15; explicit formal coefficient and adjunction argument

proof.text: Define the ambient categories and typed pull, push, reduction and composition wrappers from the actual library constructions.
Take the displayed pull isomorphisms and their composition equation as fields; construct the push natural transformation using mateEquiv.

Expose the actual derived extension/restriction adjunction through the typed reduction wrapper. The two functors in c.pull are composite left adjoints; transport the first composite adjunction along c.pull and apply rightAdjointUniq against the second. This constructs restrictPushIso without flatness or preservation of injectives by restriction.
